basic_info.description: Charming remodeled corner unit condo in the beautiful Hamilton Building with 24 hour door person. Private exterior views of San Francisco, new paint & flooring, mirror closet doors, ceiling fan, newly refinished bathtub & original period details. This building is like a piece of fine art, with soaring high ceiling in the wonderful lobby with grand piano and high-end finishes. Views are stunning from the stylish roof-top deck. You will love this well-preserved time capsule. Close to transportation, restaurants and city night life. Complete with fitness center & HOA costs include heat, water, electricity & trash.
